unit.why: A short narrative: three tsaddikim (the Kozienice Maggid, the Seer of Lublin, R. Mendele of Przytyk) agreed to pray for redemption on Simhat Torah 1815, and all three died that same year.

stories.start_quote: עו"ש בשם הרה״ג מו״ה חיים דובער גראס
stories.end_quote: [א"ה ויבא מזה במע׳ מרן מלובלין זי״ע]
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Kozienice, the Seer of Lublin and R. Mendele of Przytyk, bound by deep love, agreed to plead for the hastening of redemption on Shemini Atzeret 1815. Because of the generation's sins the Maggid died on the eve of Sukkot, and the other two died later that same year.
